hero.title: The platform that walks beside your family, every day.
hero.subtitle: My Blue World connects parents, children, therapists and schools in one place. Routines, therapies, mood, medications, reports, and an AI that learns from the child's daily life.
hero.trust: Built with the support of families and neurodevelopment professionals

heroPreview.aiMessage: Bento's sleep improved 22% this week. Let's keep the 8:30pm routine, it worked for the last 5 days.

pillars.title: One ecosystem, many lives.
pillars.subtitle: My Blue World was born for autism, but grows with any neurodevelopmental condition: ADHD, dyslexia, Down syndrome, ODD, giftedness, and more.

items.title: Organized family
items.description: Routine, calendar, medications, mood, and behavior in a single, welcoming dashboard.

items.title: Delighted child
items.description: An experience that feels like play. Avatar, world, missions, and an AI that chats like a friend.

items.title: Integrated professionals
items.description: Therapists and schools receive real context, apply assessments, and return reports in real time.

items.title: Real AI
items.description: Not a chatbot. An assistant that remembers the child's history and suggests paths based on data.

modules.title: Everything talks to each other.
modules.subtitle: Every activity feeds the timeline, generates reports, informs the AI, and refines recommendations.
items: Complete clinical profile of the child

ai.title: An AI that knows your child.
ai.description: My Blue World talks in natural language, creates personalized social stories to prepare for new moments, and identifies patterns that go unnoticed in daily life.
bullets: Social stories to prepare for appointments, trips, and changes
Routine suggestions based on what works
ai.disclaimer: My Blue World's AI is a support tool. It never replaces healthcare or education professionals.
